hooks.name: Keep the skeleton a skeleton
hooks.description: After the agent edits a file, checks that shared code stays app-agnostic, apps don't import each other, and consent and validation rules hold.

action.prompt: If you just changed a file under skeleton/: it must not import from ghost-words/ or echo-archive/, must not contain app-specific styling, and every pure function must stay covered by properties in skeleton/src/skeleton.test.ts. If you changed LanguagePack, bump PACK_FORMAT and keep the export/import round-trip property passing. If you changed an app: it may import only from skeleton/src and its own folder. In echo-archive, a recording must never be saved without the consent checkbox, and export must still warn about "community only" recordings.
